subject_description: a TV home shopping host in a black suit, white shirt and dark red tie, white made-up face, large black eyes, holding a microphone
initial_pose: standing turned three-quarters to the right, leaning slightly forward, left hand holding the microphone at chest height, right arm extended down to the right with the open palm facing up, closed-lip smile
description: talks to the camera like an amazed salesman: the large black eyes stay as they are and the eyebrows shoot up, the mouth opens and closes over and over as if speaking; the head pulls back a little in surprise; the hand holding the microphone stays near the chest; the free right hand flies up from the counter and opens wide with the palm facing the camera; then settles back into the starting pose
